Dataset card license: odc-by (read via HF API 2026-10-06, not legal review). Subset finemath-4plus is PROVISIONAL (configs available: finemath-3plus, finemath-4plus, infiwebmath-3plus, infiwebmath-4plus); 4plus is the higher-quality, smaller filter. Upstream page terms not reviewed.

split_policy: document-level, deterministic: sha256(source_id + doc_key) mod 1000 < 5 -> validation
dedup: exact (sha256 of normalized text) + near-duplicate (word-5-gram MinHash-LSH, threshold 0.8, src/ivy_model/cleaning.py). At 0.8 only near-identical copies are caught (1% word edits caught, 5% not); tune the threshold on a real sample. Throughput measured on synthetic text only.
eval_decontamination: 13-gram overlap removal implemented (--decontaminate-file) for eval items with >=13 words. NOT sufficient for the short Ivy scenario utterances: those are guarded on the SFT side with `python -m ivy_model.cleaning check-sft`. No benchmark files have been supplied yet, so nothing has been decontaminated.
secret_scrubbing: regex scrub of common token formats, private-key blocks, emails and `key = "value"` assignments -> <SECRET>/<EMAIL>. A floor, not a guarantee: misses unknown formats, over-matches some code; no other PII (names, phones, addresses) handled.
